summary: Kartoon Studios filed an 8-K/A amending the final expiration time of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) adopted July 1, 2026. The amendment corrected the expiration to June 29, 2027. The Rights Agreement deters any person or group from acquiring 10% or more of common stock without board approval by triggering significant dilution. Each Right entitles the holder to buy one one-thousandth of a share of Series D Preferred Stock at $3.75. There is no acquisition, tender offer, or special situation; this is a routine governance document correction. No deal terms apply.
